defects.what: The 12 mm lip is a flat horizontal ring 18 mm above the bed with nothing under it: a 90 degree overhang all the way round that will droop or fail without supports. It needs a 45 degree chamfer or gusset underneath.
defects.credit: Any finding that the lip is an unsupported/flat overhang that needs support or a chamfer underneath.

defects.what: A 0.8 mm (4-layer) floor and 1.5 mm walls are too thin to hold water reliably in FDM PETG; the skill's PETG guidance is at least 2 mm (5 perimeters) for waterproof containers, and more solid floor layers.
defects.credit: Any finding that the floor and/or walls are too thin to be watertight / will leak.

defects.what: wall_t = 1.5 mm is not a whole number of 0.45 mm extrusion widths (3.33 perimeters).
defects.credit: Any finding that the wall thickness is not an integer multiple of the extrusion width.

defects.what: ef_chamfer is defined but never applied to the bottom edge.
defects.credit: Any finding that elephant-foot compensation is missing or ef_chamfer is unused.
